d: Misa Bharti On Police Encounter :bihar men pulis enkauntar ko lekar siyasi ghamasan tej ho gaya hai. RJD sansad misa bharti ne rajy men ho rahe enkauntar par saval uthate hue puchha hai ki pulis ko is tarah enkauntar karne ka adhikar kisne diya? unhonne pulis ki karravaee aur kanun-vyavastha ko lekar javab manga hai. misa bharti ke is bayan ke bad bihar ki rajniti men naee bahas chhir gaee hai. aakhir enkauntar ko lekar misa bharti ne kya kaha? pulis ki karravaee par unke savalon ke kya mayne hain? dekhie puri riporta.
